entities.summary: The Brescia–Iseo–Edolo railway is a 104 km (65 mi) long regional railway line connecting the towns of Brescia, Iseo, and Edolo, in Lombardy, northern Italy. The railway links the Valcamonica valley and the Lake Iseo with the city of Brescia and the rest of the Italian railway network.
